clinics_settings_lengths.name: clinics_settings_lengths
clinics_settings_lengths.value: length("clinic_app"."clinics"."address") <= 300 and length("clinic_app"."clinics"."receipt_header") <= 200 and length("clinic_app"."clinics"."receipt_footer") <= 300 and length("clinic_app"."clinics"."ntn") <= 30 and length("clinic_app"."clinics"."phone") <= 30 and length("clinic_app"."clinics"."city") <= 80 and "clinic_app"."clinics"."settings_version" > 0

appointments_text_lengths.name: appointments_text_lengths
appointments_text_lengths.value: length("clinic_app"."appointments"."reason") <= 240 and length("clinic_app"."appointments"."notes") <= 1000 and length("clinic_app"."appointments"."next_action") <= 240 and ("clinic_app"."appointments"."override_reason" is null or length(trim("clinic_app"."appointments"."override_reason")) between 3 and 300)

closing_draft_amounts.name: closing_draft_amounts
closing_draft_amounts.value: "clinic_app"."closing_drafts"."opening_minor" between 0 and 99999999 and "clinic_app"."closing_drafts"."counted_minor" between 0 and 99999999 and "clinic_app"."closing_drafts"."version">0

staff_invites_inviter_present.name: staff_invites_inviter_present
staff_invites_inviter_present.value: ("clinic_app"."staff_invites"."invited_by_operator_id" is not null) <> ("clinic_app"."staff_invites"."invited_by_membership_id" is not null)
